content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Distributes plumbing, HVAC and fire products to contractors; it is a wholesale distributor, not a building-systems installer and service provider."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Electrical contracting, installation and maintenance for commercial and data center building owners, similar to APi's specialty contracting services."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Engineering, consulting and government program services; it does not install or maintain building safety and mechanical systems."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Installs, maintains and services mechanical, electrical and plumbing systems for commercial building owners, closely matching APi's specialty services."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Mechanical, electrical and plumbing contracting plus recurring building-systems service for commercial and institutional owners, closely matching APi."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures coatings, sealants and consumer paints sold through retail and distributors; it is a materials maker, not a contracting service provider."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Inspection and repair for refineries and petrochemical plants; industrial customers and end markets differ from APi's building safety work."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Rents and launders uniforms and supplies to businesses; a rental and laundering model, not fire protection or building systems services."}]}
